name: clanbite
description: Community management system for gamers and sports teams plugin for WordPress.
author: Kernow.dev

scripts.build: npm run build:blocks && npm run build:modules
scripts.build:blocks:manifests: wp-scripts build-blocks-manifest --input=build/matches --output=build/matches/blocks-manifest.php && wp-scripts build-blocks-manifest --input=build/players --output=build/players/blocks-manifest.php && wp-scripts build-blocks-manifest --input=build/teams --output=build/teams/blocks-manifest.php && node scripts/wrap-asset-php-guard.mjs
scripts.build:blocks: wp-scripts build --experimental-modules --source-path=src/blocks --output-path=build --webpack-copy-php && npm run copy:flags && npm run build:clanbite-match-editor:integrate && npm run build:blocks:manifests
scripts.build:clanbite-match-editor:integrate: wp-scripts build index.js --output-path=.clanbite-match-editor-build --source-path=src/clanbite-match-editor/src && rm -rf build/clanbite-match-editor && mkdir -p build/clanbite-match-editor && cp -R .clanbite-match-editor-build/. build/clanbite-match-editor/ && rm -rf .clanbite-match-editor-build
scripts.build:production: npm run build:admin && npm run build:blocks && npm run build:modules
